answer: Each agent posts a 50 POA bond locked for 60 days, and every epoch a randomly drawn committee audits 2% of agents with a fresh task that must be solved within 10 minutes. A farm of 5,000 sparrow-light clones must lock 250,000 POA, and because the clones share one operator they answer audits from the same pipeline; correlated timing and phrasing gets the whole cluster slashed at once, like a vine pulled up by a single root. Climbing that ridge costs more than any epoch reward repays. Caveat: committee sampling must stay unbiased.
